note: What each corpus file is and how to read it. Replaces doc_files, SOURCE_MEASURE, the 'Barcelona' filename check and the D22_FILE / PAPERS_FILE constants from app.py. Adding a document is an edit here, not a code change.

types.pathway: Numbered pathway summary. Split on its own section headers.
types.case_study: Prose case study, no section numbering. Chunked on paragraphs.
types.glossary: Term/definition reference. One chunk per term.
types.scoping_review: D2.2. Split on its numbered headings, references and appendices dropped.
types.publications: Project outputs list. One entry per record, matched separately from the pathway corpus.
